text:
Ravi P (People Ops): Quick heads-up 3:30 courier left a small box at the lobby with a hand-written name 'Saffron' but no company. Left a sticky note but sprinted out. Anyone expecting anything? :thinking:
Samira: Not me. Checked my orders, none are Saffron. Could be for marketing or an agency?
Jonah R: We have a guest at 14:00 from Acme Partners. Maybe that's them? They said they'd bring collateral but I thought they'd carry it.
Front Desk Bot: Noted. Package scanned as PKG-2207. Location: Shelf B2 (near plants). Photo uploaded: pkg-2207.jpg. Status: unclaimed.
Ravi P (People Ops): Thanks bot. Moving to Secure Locker 1 now and leaving a pickup slip at the desk. Locker access: code 2207 (expires in 48h).
Ravi P (People Ops): Also: the Acme visitor will need a temporary badge and a seat by the conference room. Is hotdesk 4 available for 2 hours?
Jonah R: Hotdesk 4 is clear after 14:15. I can ask the team to hold it until 16:30.
Samira: I can swap from 4 to the standing bench if that helps.
Ravi P (People Ops): That would help a lot, thanks @Samira. Putting a paper tag on desk 4 with 'Acme guest 14:00-16:30'.
Visitor Bot: Reminder: Guest check-in for Acme Partners at 14:00. Please have ID ready.
Samira: One more thing 3:45 the fridge has an unlabelled container. If it's yours, mark it before tomorrow or I'll donate it to the snack table :pray:
Jonah R: That's probably leftover curry. :grimacing: I'll claim it now.
Ravi P (People Ops): Closing the loop: locker tag PKG-2207 + my initials. If not claimed by Monday it goes to lost-and-found for 10 days. Posting a short note in #general for remote folks to DM if they sent it.
Front Desk Bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-30T18:00:00Z check PKG-2207.
Samira: Nice and tidy. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Jonah R: Cheers :coffee:
Ravi P (People Ops): Thanks team!
